user.title: Recteq Grill
user.description:
Enter the name and communication parameters for your Recteq grill.

Visit [the wiki](https://github.com/pdugas/homeassistant-recteq/wiki) for assistance figuring out these values.

error.invalid_host: The Host is invalid. Please enter a valid '#.#.#.#' IPv4 address.
error.invalid_device_id: The Device ID is invalid. Please enter 22 hex digits.
error.invalid_local_key: The Local Key is invalid. Please enter 16 hex digits.
error.invalid_protocol: The Protocol is invalid. Please enter 3.1, 3.3, or 3.4.
